contexts.general: Existing catalog-aware v1 leaseScope reference over the complete typed allow array and raw candidate; not a universal ingress policy. consumerOverrides map named seam exceptions. Go enforces 2048 bytes and runs its protected checks, kernel rule is generic up to 8192 without a protected-host policy. BIOS must independently enforce the pilot protected deny list. WASI proves emitted/absent typed request and command, not authority.
contexts.pilot: Single initial typed exact rule, byte-identical canonical HTTPS href at intake and at externally supplied goto. A true means syntactic eligibility, not authority. Reject parent, query and fragment even when empty. ASCII DNS A-label multi-label host, no trailing dot, IP/numeric alias, localhost or single-label. Canonical non-default port allowed. Path is root or slash-delimited nonempty ASCII unreserved segments, optional trailing slash, no dot/dotdot, NO percent escapes of any kind. Cap 2048 UTF-8 bytes before/after serialization. Never widen/fallback/retry. False pilot columns for a valid origin are not a legacy-origin refusal. Root and a terminal slash are distinct; nonterminal empty path segments are forbidden. Admission assumes other checks such as the 900s pilot term and holder are already satisfied. In pilot syntax failures, no emitted command and no adapter call; never infer that for a valid independent legacy origin.
contexts.grantEcho: Given independently valid signed grant and bound context, compare immutable offerAllow and grantAllow cardinality, canonical kind and URL byte-for-byte. sameTypedSingleRule tests identity even when not eligible for this pilot; additionally require valid D2 offer for pilotGrantAccepted. False means zero data OPENs and zero browser dispatch (not zero request control OPENs). Kill kind-only mutant at tuple-comparison unit seam; an earlier kind/prefix rejection must not be reported as that mutant kill.
contexts.ownerReview: Compare proven requests to the owner-selected holder, rule tuple and duration using the actual emitted command in POSIX argv; quote each accepted exact URL atom. Negative D2 input must not produce an owner line. PTY compatibility is separate from signing and production release evidence. offer is the proven pending broker request. owner is the decoded owner review line. expectedLine names the owner-side test input, and only the positive case also specifies exact WASI output. A mismatched line in a negative case is not output expected from a legitimate producer.
contexts.finalDocument: unverified-R12: no row asserts the final committed URL, generation or disclosure after redirect. Broker R12 owns that verification.

exactInitialPilotCandidate.freeze: Candidate data only. Record acceptance separately against the unchanged digest after WASI, kernel, BIOS and Go have each run and acknowledged these exact bytes in CI. A discrepancy is a named finding, not an expected-pass waiver. No authority, dispatch, final-document identity, deployment or release follows from this digest.

exactInitialPilotCases.policy: catalog.protectedOrigins: the shared reference and Go apply the protected catalog at rule validation; the BIOS pilot must deny this protected surface, while the generic kernel rule checks syntax only.
